dedupe_keys.name: historical and future irrigation water demand for the stars4water river basins

description: The STARS4Water dataset compares historical and projected summer irrigation requirements across seven European river basins and supplies their boundaries. Results distinguish climate models and time windows. The metadata is published or maintained by Giełczewski, Marek; Piniewski, Mikołaj (provider deposit/publication). Coverage is seven European river basins, with mean summer irrigation requirements for five climate models and two time windows. It includes basin-boundary shapefiles. The provider landing page describes access to Shapefile, text material. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The inspected public record or source repository is free to read; this does not grant rights beyond its stated licence. Caveats: Independent reuse and ongoing maintenance were not established; admission depends on the open single-study rule. For infrastructure simulation, its documented contents can support climate adaptation. These are catalogue-use assessments, not additional validation claims. Related catalogue context is data-fao-aquastat-main-database. This is a thematic comparison, not a verified software dependency or claim of compatible inputs.
